note: docs/design/FLOOR.md Appendix B row 16's plate names (card#7343, the operator's rulings of 2026-09-27: a plate's name, and then its status line, are drawn at the lobby page's own body text size and the camera never scales them). Each run is `building_rides`' entry — `fx-snapshot-4` under the building layout, drawn on the harness's default 1280 × 800 surface — under a layout of N floors: `aimla`, `zeta` labelled *the annex*, and N − 2 more floors of one room each that the fleet reports no seat for. The viewer zooms in once with a Ctrl+wheel, pans with a plain wheel (card#11045: the plain wheel pans, Ctrl+wheel and the pinch zoom), asks for the whole building (a glide back to fit) and rides (a glide to a plate). `Tests\Feature\Floor\ThePlateNameIsReadAtTheBodyTextSizeTest` reads the size on the screen of each plate's name and status line at fit, after each wheel and halfway through each glide.
